assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas for Legionnaires. Image 1 is an identity/color reference only, NOT an edit target. Create an entirely new crisp pixel-art battle sprite sheet of this Roman centurion, with the same red cloak, red curved shield, bronze helmet/crest and iron/leather Roman kit, simplified into readable chunky pixel clusters, small expressive head and compact 3-head-tall body. Original character art, no copied game characters. Isometric game camera looking down about 30 degrees; key light upper left, strong clean silhouette, restrained red/bronze/slate palette, no painterly blur or antialiased illustration shading. ONE character in FIVE separate poses on a precisely regular 2-column by 3-row atlas: top-left standing front facing southeast, top-right standing front facing southwest, middle-left back facing northeast, middle-right back facing northwest, bottom-left lying fallen on side, bottom-right completely empty transparent. Both standing views and rear views show appropriate shield in anatomical left hand and short sword in right hand. Each pose fully contained and centered in its own equal cell with a generous transparent gutter; consistent body scale and foot baseline within cells. No text, labels, grid lines, floor tile, scenery, cast shadow blob, background color, border, or watermark. Genuine transparent background. Pixel-art sprites with deliberate pixel clusters, suitable for downsampling into 128x160 sprite cells. Sheet should be portrait 2:3 if possible.
